description: tests/common/mod.rs line 131: pub fn store_blob(&self, blob_id: Id, bytes: Vec<u8>). The bytes parameter takes Vec<u8> by value (move). For a test helper this is fine, but the blob_id takes Id by value rather than &Id (or impl Into<Id>). This is inconsistent with every MailBackend trait method which takes &jmap_types::Id. The practical effect is that test code must clone() or move the id explicitly, creating friction. Since MemoryBackend is the canonical example for MailBackend implementors, the parameter asymmetry (methods take &Id, this helper takes Id) trains readers to think owned is preferred. Should be: pub fn store_blob(&self, blob_id: &Id, bytes: Vec<u8>) consistent with trait method signatures.
title: MemoryBackend.store_blob takes Vec<u8> by value — forces caller to own
